tour_type.morning: ⛪ Sagrada Família: Start your day with Gaudí’s most iconic masterpiece — towering spires, dreamy shapes and surreal details. A must-see morning landmark. → | 🏛️ Passeig de Gràcia Walk: Continue down this elegant boulevard filled with modernist buildings, palm trees and stylish city energy. → | 🏠 Casa Batlló (Exterior): Vibrant colors, wavy shapes and postcard-perfect architecture — you can admire the outside without entering if you prefer. → | ☕ Eixample Café Break: Relax in a cozy café with pastries, warm drinks and chill urban atmosphere.
tour_type.afternoon: 🏰 Gothic Quarter (Barri Gòtic): Wander through medieval streets, tiny squares, stone arches and local shops — pure atmospheric magic. → | 🌿 Parc de la Ciutadella: Huge park with lakes, palm trees, fountains and green corners — perfect for walking or relaxing. → | 🍽️ Catalan-Style Lunch: Try tapas (non-seafood options available), veggie paella, patatas bravas, tortilla or fresh salads. → | 🎨 El Born Cultural Corners: Small galleries, craft shops and lively streets with lots of personality.
tour_type.sunset: 🌅 Barceloneta Beach: Chill golden-hour vibes — soft waves, warm light on the sand and a relaxing ocean breeze. Perfect for photos and a slow, dreamy sunset.
tour_type.night: 🌃 Port Vell & Marina Walk (non-alcoholic): Soft lights reflecting on the water, gelato stands, dessert places, smoothies and lively but safe evening energy.
tour_type.full_day: Morning: ⛪ Sagrada Família: Gaudí’s dreamlike basilica with surreal towers. → | 🏛️ Passeig de Gràcia: Elegant avenue of modernist buildings. → | 🏠 Casa Batlló (Exterior): Wavy, colorful Gaudí icon. → | ☕ Eixample Café: Cozy urban break with pastries.;Afternoon: 🏰 Gothic Quarter: Medieval alleys, arches and tiny plazas. → | 🌿 Parc de la Ciutadella: Lakes, palm trees and calm green corners. → | 🍽️ Catalan Lunch: Tapas, veggie paella, patatas bravas. → | 🎨 El Born: Creative district with galleries and indie shops.;Sunset: 🌅 Barceloneta Beach: Warm seaside golden-hour glow.;Night: 🌃 Port Vell Marina: Gelato stands, dessert cafés and calm waterfront walk.

interest_descriptions.Architecture & Landmarks 🏛️: Barcelona is full of world-famous buildings, from Gaudí’s surreal masterpieces to medieval Gothic structures.
interest_descriptions.Seaside & Relaxing Walks 🌊: Mediterranean breezes, long beaches, palm-lined boulevards and calm sunset moments define the coastal vibe.
interest_descriptions.Art & Museums 🎨: Picasso, Gaudí, street art zones and modern galleries make the city a paradise for art lovers.
interest_descriptions.Local Food Exploration 😋: Tapas, paella, fresh salads, patatas bravas, pastries and plenty of veggie-friendly options.
interest_descriptions.Urban Culture & Street Vibes 🎭: Street performers, lively neighborhoods, open squares and creative energy everywhere you turn.

food_descriptions.Local Specialties: Catalan dishes such as vegetarian paella, tapas, tortilla, patatas bravas and fresh bread with tomato.
food_descriptions.Fast Food: Pizza slices, crepes, bakery snacks, smoothies and easy street-food near the beach.
food_descriptions.Vegetarian: Barcelona is super veggie-friendly — plant-based paella, salads, veggie tapas and international spots.
food_descriptions.Mixed Options: Most restaurants serve a blend of Mediterranean classics and modern dishes for all diets.

tour_type.morning: 🏰 Royal Palace of Madrid (Exterior): Start your day at the grand royal palace — huge plazas, stunning façades and a very regal morning atmosphere. → | ⛪ Almudena Cathedral (Exterior): Another beautiful landmark right next door — perfect for quick photos and calm early vibes. → | 🏛️ Plaza de Oriente Walk: Palm trees, sculptures and a scenic open space connecting the palace area. → | ☕ Gran Vía Café Break: Head toward Madrid’s famous boulevard and enjoy pastries, warm drinks and the lively city rhythm.
tour_type.afternoon: 🎨 Prado Museum (Exterior or Interior): Choose between admiring the architecture from the outside or exploring world-famous artworks inside — totally up to your pace. → | 🌿 Retiro Park: Giant lawns, shaded paths, fountains, swan-filled lake and the *Crystal Palace* — one of the most peaceful and pretty spots in the entire city. → | 🍽️ Spanish Lunch: Try tortilla española, patatas bravas, vegetarian paella, sandwiches, or fresh salads — super tasty and very teen-friendly. → | 🏞️ Crystal Palace (Palacio de Cristal): A dreamy glass building inside Retiro with exhibitions and soft natural light.
tour_type.sunset: 🌅 Temple of Debod: An ancient Egyptian temple gifted to Spain — one of Madrid’s best sunset spots with golden light over the city skyline.
tour_type.night: 🌃 Plaza Mayor & Surrounding Streets (non-alcoholic): Evening lights, dessert spots, churros con chocolate, ice cream stands and a calm, friendly, lively atmosphere perfect for a safe nighttime stroll.
tour_type.full_day: Morning: 🏛️ Puerta del Sol: Iconic city center point. → | 🕍 Plaza Mayor: Historic square with arcades and cafés. → | 🖼️ Royal Palace (Exterior): Majestic façade and gardens. → | ☕ Opera District Café: Relaxed morning drink.; Afternoon: 🎨 Prado Museum: Classic masterpieces (youth-friendly highlights). → | 🌳 Retiro Park: Lakes, trees and green spaces. → | 🍽️ Madrid Lunch: Tortilla, veggie tapas, soups. → | 🌸 Crystal Palace Exterior: Glass pavilion in the park.; Sunset: 🌅 Temple of Debod (Exterior): Sunset over ancient-styled silhouette. ; Night: 🌃 Gran Vía Walk: Bright lights, shops and dessert places.

tour_type.morning: 🏛️ City of Arts and Sciences (Exterior): Start your day at Valencia’s futuristic icon — dreamy white architecture, water reflections and giant sci-fi shapes. Amazing for photos. → | 🌿 Turia River Park Walk: A huge green park built in a former riverbed — palm trees, bike lanes, fountains, bridges and relaxed morning energy. → | 🏰 Torres de Serranos (Exterior): Impressive medieval towers guarding the entrance to the old town. Great viewpoint from the outside area. → | ☕ Old Town Café Break: Chill moment in a rustic Valencian café with pastries, horchata (non-alcoholic local drink!) and calm vibes.
tour_type.afternoon: 🏘️ Valencia Old Town (El Carmen): Wander through colorful alleys, street art walls, small squares, craft shops and ancient city corners. → | ⛪ Valencia Cathedral (Exterior): Famous for its tower and mixed architecture styles — peaceful and impressive. → | 🍽️ Local Lunch: Try paella Valenciana (chicken/veggie versions available), patatas bravas, tortilla, salads or light Mediterranean dishes. → | 🌿 Plaza de la Virgen: A bright, open square with a fountain, orange trees and historic façades — perfect for relaxing after lunch.
tour_type.sunset: 🌅 Malvarrosa Beach: Soft Mediterranean waves, warm sand and golden-hour light — ideal for chill sunset moments and relaxing photography.
tour_type.night: 🌃 Marina Walk & Beach Promenade (non-alcoholic): A lively but safe waterfront area with dessert places, ice cream, churros, smoothies and warm evening lights reflecting on the sea.
tour_type.full_day: Morning: 🏛️ Valencia Cathedral (Exterior): Gothic beauty and lively plaza. → | 🏰 El Carmen Streets: Colorful murals and narrow lanes. → | 🏺 Silk Exchange (Exterior): UNESCO Gothic monument. → | ☕ Old-Town Café: Chill morning pause.; Afternoon: 🧪 City of Arts & Sciences (Exterior): Futuristic architecture. → | 🌿 Turia Gardens: Long green park perfect for strolling. → | 🍽️ Valencian Lunch: Veggie paella, soups, fresh salads. → | 🐬 Oceanographic Exterior Walk: Scenic fountains and ponds.; Sunset: 🌅 Malvarrosa Beach: Wide sandy beach with warm evening light.; Night: 🌃 Marina Promenade: Ice cream, soft drinks and peaceful seaside walk.

interest_descriptions.Futuristic Architecture 🏛️: Valencia’s City of Arts and Sciences is a massive, surreal architectural zone that feels like walking through a sci-fi movie.
interest_descriptions.Seaside & Beach Walks 🌊: Long sandy beaches, warm Mediterranean breeze and perfect golden-hour chill moments.
interest_descriptions.Parks & Nature 🌿: Turia Park is one of Europe’s biggest urban parks — shaded paths, fountains, bridges and endless greenery.
interest_descriptions.Art & Museums 🎨: From modern art in IVAM to street murals in El Carmen — Valencia is full of color and creativity.
interest_descriptions.Local Food Exploration 😋: Paella Valenciana, tortilla, patatas bravas, horchata and tons of vegetarian Mediterranean dishes.
interest_descriptions.Urban Culture & Old Town Streets 🎭: Colorful, lively and full of personality — ancient alleys mixed with modern cafés and street performers.

food_descriptions.Vegetarian: Veggie paellas, salads, tapas, Mediterranean bowls and plenty of plant-based cafés.
food_descriptions.Mixed Options: Most places offer traditional Spanish meals plus international or modern lighter variations.

tour_type.morning: ⛪ Seville Cathedral (Exterior): Start your day at one of the largest Gothic cathedrals in the world — massive towers, intricate details and a majestic morning atmosphere. → | 🗼 La Giralda (Exterior Viewpoint): Admire the iconic bell tower from outside — unique mix of Moorish and Renaissance design. Great for photos. → | 🏛️ Archivo de Indias (Exterior Walk): A historic building full of colonial-era history — peaceful exterior walk with bright Andalusian light. → | ☕ Santa Cruz Café Break: Relax in one of the cozy cafés hidden in the narrow, whitewashed streets of the famous old neighborhood.
tour_type.afternoon: 🏰 Real Alcázar Gardens (Exterior Areas / Nearby Walk): Explore the stunning gardens around the palace: palm trees, fountains, tiled walls and colorful courtyards. Even from outside zones, the vibe is magical. → | 🌿 María Luisa Park: Huge, dreamy park filled with fountains, ponds, flowers, palm avenues and shaded trails — great for relaxing. → | 🏛️ Plaza de España: One of Europe’s most beautiful squares — tiled bridges, boats on the canal, and a fairytale-like backdrop perfect for photos. → | 🍽️ Andalusian Lunch: Try gazpacho, tortilla, veggie paella, patatas bravas, spinach with chickpeas, or fresh Mediterranean dishes.
tour_type.sunset: 🌅 Triana Riverside: Chill sunset along the Guadalquivir River — golden light glowing over bridges, calm reflections and soft breeze.
tour_type.night: 🌃 Triana Neighborhood (non-alcoholic): Colorful ceramic shops, dessert cafés, ice cream spots, soft lighting and friendly evening atmosphere. Totally safe and lively without needing nightlife.
tour_type.full_day: Morning: 🏰 Plaza de España: Iconic tiled arches and canals. → | 🌿 Maria Luisa Park: Palm trees, fountains and shaded paths. → | ⛪ Seville Cathedral (Exterior): Grand Gothic façade. → | ☕ Santa Cruz Café: Cozy break in historic lanes.; Afternoon: 🌸 Barrio Santa Cruz: Colorful lanes and patios. → | 🏛️ Archivo de Indias (Exterior): Historic colonial archive building. → | 🍽️ Andalusian Lunch: Gazpacho, veggie tapas, tortillas. → | 🌿 Riverside Walk: Calm paths along the Guadalquivir.; Sunset: 🌅 Triana Riverside: Golden light over bridges and rooftops.; Night: 🌃 Torre del Oro Walk: Soft-lit waterfront with dessert stops.

food_descriptions.Mixed Options: Most restaurants serve both traditional Andalusian dishes and modern international meals.

tour_type.morning: 🏰 Alcazaba (Exterior Paths): Start your day at the hillside Moorish fortress — palm trees, stone walls and beautiful morning views over the city. → | 🏛️ Roman Theatre: Located right below the fortress — a calm and photogenic archaeological site. → | 🎨 Picasso Museum (Exterior or Interior): Visit the exterior for quick photos or step inside to explore works from Picasso’s early life. → | ☕ Old Town Café Break: Enjoy pastries, fresh juice or Spanish-style coffee in narrow, bright Andalusian streets.
tour_type.afternoon: 🌿 Parque de Málaga: Huge green park with fountains, palm avenues, parrots, shade and a tropical vibe — perfect for a relaxing walk. → | 🌊 Port of Málaga (Muelle Uno): A modern waterfront area with sea views, colorful shops, ocean breeze and chill energy. → | 🍽️ Mediterranean Lunch: Try veggie paella, tortilla española, grilled vegetables, patatas bravas or light salads — super tasty and teen-friendly. → | 🎨 Centre Pompidou Málaga (Exterior): Iconic colorful glass cube — perfect for photos and a quick cultural stop.

tour_type.night: 🌃 Soho Street-Art District (non-alcoholic): Colorful murals, dessert cafés, ice cream spots, churros, smoothies and evening creativity everywhere. Safe and lively for a relaxed night walk.

interest_descriptions.Parks & Nature 🌿: Lush, tropical-style parks and calm green zones perfect for shade and relaxation.

interest_descriptions.Urban Culture & Old Town Streets 🎭: Lively alleys, bright plazas and creative zones like Soho make the city vibrant.

tour_type.morning: 🏰 Alhambra (Exterior Zones / Nearby Viewpoints): Begin your day with one of Spain’s most magical landmarks — Moorish towers, forested paths and peaceful morning air. Even without entering, the outer gardens and viewpoints are stunning. → | 🌿 Alhambra Forest Walk: Shady walking paths with fountains, streams and stone bridges — calm and refreshing. → | 🕍 Plaza Nueva: A lively square at the foot of the Albaicín district with bright façades and relaxed energy. → | ☕ Café by the Darro River: Chill morning break with pastries, tea or fresh juice right next to the small riverside street.
tour_type.afternoon: 🏘️ Albaicín District (Mirador Walk): Wander through narrow whitewashed streets, old houses, small craft shops and hidden corners. → | 🌄 Mirador de San Nicolás (Exterior Area): One of the best views in Spain — Alhambra glowing on the hill with the Sierra Nevada mountains behind it. → | 🍽️ Andalusian-Moorish Lunch: Enjoy couscous, veggie tajines, tortilla, hummus varieties, salads and light Mediterranean plates. → | 🎨 Paseo de los Tristes: Famous cobblestone street along the Darro River — colorful houses, mountains and peaceful scenery.

interest_descriptions.Historic Landmarks 🏛️: Granada is full of stone walls, ancient streets, Renaissance squares and legendary viewpoints.
interest_descriptions.Moorish Architecture 🕌: From the Alhambra to Albaicín, the city blends arches, tiles, courtyards, fountains and soft desert-inspired design.
interest_descriptions.Parks & Nature 🌿: Shaded forests, river paths and mountain viewpoints give Granada a calm, natural atmosphere.
interest_descriptions.Art & Museums 🎨: Street artists, classical museums and local craft shops make the city a colorful cultural hub.
interest_descriptions.Local Food Exploration 😋: Mediterranean dishes, couscous, veggie tajines, tortillas, patatas bravas and delicious pastries.
interest_descriptions.Old Town Culture 🎭: Narrow alleys, white houses, bright squares and lively evening streets create Granada’s charming character.

food_descriptions.Local Specialties: Couscous, veggie tajines, Andalusian salads, tortilla, patatas bravas and sweet pastries influenced by Moorish cuisine.
food_descriptions.Fast Food: Smoothies, sandwiches, wraps, pizza slices and street-side snacks.
food_descriptions.Vegetarian: Tons of veggie-friendly options including couscous bowls, salads, grilled veggies and Mediterranean plates.
food_descriptions.Mixed Options: Most restaurants offer traditional Andalusian–Moorish dishes plus modern international meals.

tour_type.morning: 🎨 Guggenheim Museum (Exterior): Start your day at Bilbao’s iconic modern landmark — the metallic curves, giant outdoor sculptures and river reflections look amazing in morning light. Great for photos even without entering. → | 🐶 Puppy Sculpture: The huge flower-covered dog guarding the museum — colorful, fun and super photogenic. → | 🌊 Riverside Walk (Nervión River): Calm, clean promenades with bridges, sculptures and fresh air. → | ☕ Zubizuri Bridge Café Break: Grab a relaxing morning drink near Santiago Calatrava’s elegant white footbridge.
tour_type.afternoon: 🏙️ Old Town (Casco Viejo): Explore narrow streets, cute squares, colorful houses and local artisan shops. → | 🏛️ Plaza Nueva: Beautiful arcaded square where locals hang out — great for people-watching. → | 🍽️ Lunch with Basque Specialties: Try pintxos (small bites with veggie options), tortilla, fresh bread, grilled veggies or light Mediterranean plates. → | 🌿 Doña Casilda Park: A peaceful urban park with trees, ponds, fountains and quiet corners — perfect afternoon cooldown.
tour_type.sunset: 🌅 Artxanda Hill Funicular (Exterior Viewpoint): Ride up to the viewpoint for golden-hour views over the city, river, bridges and the mountains around Bilbao.
tour_type.night: 🌃 Riverside Promenade (Dessert-Friendly): Evening lights reflect beautifully on the river — ice cream, pastries and churros spots nearby for a safe, chill nighttime walk.
tour_type.full_day: Morning: 🕌 Mezquita-Catedral (Exterior): Unique arches and red-white patterns. → | 🏘️ Jewish Quarter: White walls, flowers, patios. → | ☕ Patio Café: Morning break in blooming courtyards.; Afternoon: 🌉 Roman Bridge: Calm walk over the river. → | 🏛️ Alcázar Gardens (Exterior): Fountains and trimmed hedges. → | 🍽️ Cordoban Lunch: Salmorejo (veg), tortilla, warm dishes. → | 🎨 Calleja de las Flores: Narrow photogenic alley.; Sunset: 🌅 Mirador del Puente Romano: Golden tones over the old city.; Night: 🌃 Historic Center Walk: Soft lights, gelato shops and relaxed streets.

tour_type.morning: 🕌 Mezquita–Cathedral (Exterior): Begin your day at Córdoba’s most iconic monument — striped arches, massive golden doors and a unique blend of cultures visible even from the outside. Majestic in the soft morning light. → | 🌉 Roman Bridge Walk: Calm riverside breeze, beautiful old-stone arches and scenic views of the historic skyline. → | 🏛️ Calahorra Tower (Exterior): A small tower at the far end of the bridge offering great angles for photos. → | ☕ Breakfast in the Jewish Quarter: Chill morning break in a whitewashed alley with pastries, juice or café con leche.
tour_type.afternoon: 🏘️ Judería (Jewish Quarter): Wander narrow medieval streets full of flowers, small craft shops, arches and hidden courtyards. → | 🌺 Calleja de las Flores: One of the most picturesque spots in all of Spain — a tiny alley filled with flower pots and a perfect view of the Mezquita’s tower. → | 🍽️ Andalusian Lunch: Enjoy salmorejo (tomato-cream dish often with veggie options), tortilla, grilled veggies, hummus-style dips or light Mediterranean meals. → | 🌿 Alcázar Gardens (Exterior Areas / Nearby Promenades): Palm trees, fountains, citrus scents and calm green paths around the palace area.
tour_type.sunset: 🌅 Riverside Sunset (Guadalquivir): Warm golden light over the bridge and water — peaceful, relaxing and amazing for photos.
tour_type.night: 🌃 Old Town Dessert Walk (non-alcoholic): Ice cream, pastries, tea rooms and softly lit stone streets — perfect for a gentle night stroll with safe, cozy vibes.

tour_type.morning: 🌋 Teide National Park (Exterior Viewpoints): Start your day among incredible volcanic landscapes — giant craters, lava fields and unreal rock formations. Even without hiking, the viewpoints are breathtaking. → | 🏜️ Roques de García (Photo Stop): Famous rock formations with dramatic backdrops. → | 🌿 Teide Scenic Roads: Smooth mountain roads with panoramic angles and clean mountain air. → | ☕ Café in Vilaflor Village: A calm mountain village perfect for a relaxing morning drink.
tour_type.afternoon: 🏘️ La Orotava Old Town: Beautiful historic houses, wooden balconies, bright colors and peaceful plazas. → | 🌿 Jardines Victoria: Elegant tiered garden with flowers, fountains and views of the valley. → | 🍽️ Canarian Lunch: Papas arrugadas (potatoes with mojo), veggie stews, grilled veggies, salads and Mediterranean bowls. → | 🎨 Casa de los Balcones (Exterior): Traditional Canary architecture — super photogenic wooden balconies and patios.
tour_type.sunset: 🌅 Playa de Benijo (Viewpoint Area): One of the most dramatic sunset locations on the island — black sand, cliffs and glowing sky colors.
tour_type.night: 🌃 Puerto de la Cruz Promenade (non-alcoholic): Soft lights, ocean breeze, ice cream, waffles, juices and relaxed night strolls along the water.
tour_type.full_day: Morning: 🌄 Mirador de Jardina: Forested viewpoint over La Laguna. → | 🏘️ La Laguna Old Town: Colorful historic façades. → | ☕ Plaza del Adelantado Café: Relaxing morning stop.; Afternoon: 🌋 Teide National Park (Exterior viewpoints): Lava fields, rock formations and volcanic scenery. → | 🍽️ Tenerife Lunch: Veggie stews, papas, salads. → | 🌿 La Esperanza Forest Road (stops): Misty pines and scenic overlooks.; Sunset: 🌅 Mirador de Chipeque: Sea of clouds glowing at golden hour.; Night: 🌃 Santa Cruz Waterfront: Calm walk with ice cream and soft lights.
